description: Shared vectors for Send to myCarlos (docs/architecture/mycarlos-delivery.md). Generated by tests/delivery_contract_reference.py; do not edit by hand. Every key is a FAKE test key derived from its seed text (keys.derivation). Receivers must accept and refuse exactly as listed. Senders cannot reproduce the seals (the ephemeral key is fixed here), so they are checked by round trip.

vault_head_link_examples.head: b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5
vault_head_link_examples.note: the same head on the device's other link: a different value

keys.derivation: key bytes = SHA-256(UTF-8 seed_text). Ed25519: the 32-byte seed. X25519: the 32-byte private key. P-256: scalar = int(key bytes, big-endian) mod (n - 1) + 1.

sender.note: What CARLOS builds for packages.accept[0]. The manifest is reproducible (RFC 8785 JSON, RFC 6979 ES256), and so are the plaintext and AAD; the seal is not, so a sender test seals with a fresh ephemeral key and opens the result with keys.device.
